accounts.caption:
Blue Arena is what happens when Blue Archive fans decide the official game’s combat isn’t quite enough—and build their own full multiplayer shooter around the students instead.
Instead of the original game’s top-down auto-battles, Blue Arena drops you into real-time matches where you personally control a Blue Archive character. You pick a student, equip whatever guns you want, and jump into team fights that mix first-person and third-person shooting. Every student has their own unique active skill, so the matches become a mix of gun skill and ability timing. Mobility is high, fights tend to be quick and aggressive, and there’s a clear sense of counterplay between different kits.
You can queue into public matches, set up private games with friends, or fight against AI. There’s also a PvE survival mode that leans into wave-based or zombie-style gameplay, sometimes set on maps inspired by familiar Blue Archive locations like Abydos. The PC version is the real one; a mobile build exists, but the community generally treats it as a stripped-down side option rather than the proper experience.
The whole project is the work of a Chinese developer known as 125690d. It’s still early in development (versions like 0.0.1 and 0.0.3 have appeared), with new maps, logos, skills, and features rolling out over time. Distribution and updates mostly happen through Chinese QQ groups and shared download links, while gameplay clips circulate on YouTube and Bilibili. Because it’s a pure fan creation, it has no official connection to Nexon or Yostar.
It’s easy to mix this up with the official game’s own PvP mode (called Tactical Competition, Arena, or Tactical Challenge depending on the server). That official mode is fully automated—your team fights another team without any real-time control. Blue Arena is the opposite: you are the one aiming, moving, and activating skills.
In short, Blue Arena is the fan community’s answer to the question “What if we could actually play as the students in a proper competitive shooter?” It’s rough around the edges in the way early fan projects often are, but it delivers exactly that fantasy—Blue Archive characters, real guns, real player skill—in a package that the original game never attempted

accounts.caption: Ch140✨Serena Rejects a Prince’s Proposal... Then Eiser Gets Jealous 📌Chapter Summary: Serena learning that Prince Hyerd has sent her a personal letter through his attendant. At the estate, she prepares the gifts and arrangements for her upcoming trip to Atiazen, unaware that the prince has another important proposal for her. During the journey, Serena reveals that Hyerd has apologized on behalf of the royal family for the previous injustice against the Serenity family and has even offered her marriage, along with favorable conditions for their future. Serena firmly rejects the proposal, explaining that she already has someone she wants to marry. Eiser calmly predicts that Hyerd will likely become king soon, leaving Serena amazed by how much he seems to know. With her feelings becoming impossible to ignore, Serena finally asks Eiser what their relationship actually is. She admits that she no longer wants them to remain in an undefined state and wishes for everyone to know that they belong to each other. Eiser does not give her a direct answer, instead telling her they have plenty of time to talk during their journey. Later, aboard the train to Atiazen, an uncomfortable silence settles between them. Eiser suddenly warns Serena to be careful of the people who may approach her, especially men whose intentions she cannot know. When Serena dismisses his concerns, Eiser reveals that many men are strongly attracted to her striking violet eyes and urges her not to take such attention lightly. His warning makes it clear that beneath his calm exterior, Eiser is far more jealous and protective than he lets on. #manhwa #manhwarecommendation #webtoon #fyp #reels

audioAnalysis.transcript: Dopo aver passato una settimana a stare al Princess Waterfensura, qui è la mia review onestamente del hotel. Il hotel stesso è assolutamente enorme, ma non è mai sentito overcrowded. I luoghi erano veramente spaziosi e avevano tutto ciò che avevamo bisogno per un stay comodissimo, includendo questo bellissimo balcone con una vista al cielo. Ci sono una selezione di area di ponte, quindi se vi viaggiate come famiglia o se vi viaggate per qualcosa di un po' più quieto in un spazio solo per adulti, c'è qualcosa per tutti. Una cosa che mi ha genuinamente sorpreso è la scelta di cibo disponibile. Ciò che mi piaceva davvero molto è che avevano giorni di tema durante la settimana e che le stazioni di cucina live significavano che il cibo non fosse mai ripetitivo. Ci sono anche diverse bar all'interno del resort, tutti con un'atmosfera completamente diversa. Quindi, se volete avere una bella bevanda in notte, o andare in un luogo più sostenibile, o solo per guardare i sport, c'è sicuramente qualcosa per tutti. Un altro punto fondamentale per me è che la piazza è a una distanza così corta e potete accessarla direttamente dal hotel. A meno che il hotel sia in una parte più tranquilla dell'islanda, sarei in grado di stare ancora? Assolutamente!

audioAnalysis.transcript: La maggior parte dei persone non lo sa, ma uno dei più bellissimi hotel di risorto che si possono esperienziare in America del Nord può sentire sorprendentemente affidabile. Benvenuti a Rio Emerald Bay in Mazatlan, Mexico, un'esplosione di mare massiva dove la vista si vede molto più costosa di quello che potresti aspettare. Con più di 1000 abitazioni, molte palle, restauranti, bar e anche il suo parco di acqua, questo posto sembra più come una città di vacanza piccola di un hotel. Ma qui è dove le cose diventano interessanti. Invece della piccola mini bar che si trova in un'hotel, alcune case hanno dispensatori di drink che sono costruiti proprio nella piazza, dando allo spazio un tocco sorprendentemente unico. touch. Step outside, and the choices keep coming. You can relax by the pools, enjoy a meal near the water, or simply spend the afternoon taking in the Pacific Ocean. And just beyond the coastline, you can see the Venados Islands, where visitors may spot seabirds and marine wildlife in the surrounding waters. But staying inside the resort isn't the only option. Head into Mazatlan and troverete il famoso Malecone, fissato con cibo locale, strade colorate, mercati, architettura e incredibili visi pacifici. Quindi qui c'è la vera domanda. Spenderesti l'intera settimana a piacere questo bellissimo resort, o lasciare l'hotel e esplorare tutto ciò che Mazatlan ha da offrire?

accounts.caption: Yolanda Saldívar has always claimed the shooting was an accident, saying she never intended to kill Selena Quintanilla-Pérez. According to Saldívar, she did not realize the gun had fired and only wanted to scare Selena away during their confrontation. However, a jury rejected that defense, and she was convicted of first-degree murder. On March 31, 1995, Selena met Yolanda Saldívar at the Days Inn in Corpus Christi, Texas, after allegations surfaced that money was missing from Selena's fan club and Selena Etc. boutiques. The meeting ended in tragedy when Selena was shot. She managed to reach the hotel lobby, where she identified Yolanda Saldívar before collapsing. Selena was rushed to Corpus Christi Memorial Hospital, where she was pronounced dead at just 23 years old. Born in Lake Jackson, Texas, and raised in Corpus Christi, Texas, Selena became the Queen of Tejano Music and one of the most influential Latin artists of all time. She was guided by her father, Abraham Quintanilla Jr., supported by her mother, Marcella Quintanilla, performed alongside her brother A.B. Quintanilla III, sister Suzette Quintanilla, and husband Chris Pérez in Selena y Los Dinos. Selena's music continues to be played around the world, with timeless classics including Como La Flor, Amor Prohibido, Bidi Bidi Bom Bom, Dreaming of You, I Could Fall in Love, No Me Queda Más, Si Una Vez, Fotos y Recuerdos, El Chico del Apartamento 512, Buenos Amigos, Techno Cumbia, La Carcacha, Cobarde, Missing My Baby, Captive Heart, I'm Getting Used to You, God's Child (Baila Conmigo), Tu Solo Tú, La Llamada, Ámame, Las Cadenas, Ya Ves, Baila Esta Cumbia, and Disco Medley. These songs helped make Selena a global icon whose influence on Tejano, Latin pop, cumbia, and Mexican-American music continues to inspire millions. Following the shooting, Yolanda Saldívar fled in her pickup truck, leading to a highly publicized police standoff before surrendering peacefully. She was convicted of first-degree murder and sentenced to life in prison with the possibility of parole after 30 years. In recent interviews, Saldívar has continued to insist the shooting was accidental and that she never intended to harm Selena, despite the jury's verdict. Today, Selena's legacy lives on through her music, her family, the Selena Museum, tributes across the world, documentaries, the 1997 film Selena, and millions of devoted fans who continue to celebrate her life and unforgettable career. accounts.caption:
AZÚCAR ROOFTOP SUNSET MIXER
 
 Azúcar restaurant @azucarpalmsprings at La Serena Villas @laserenavillas in Palm Springs has always been visually and energetically appealing to me!
 
 We experienced the magical rooftop at their rooftop sunset mixer!  This was a special event for several business owners in the area (the support from local business owners is unmatched).
 
 The energy of this place feels so good that I had to ask someone to show me around the property because I’m always down for a doing a “staycation” in our beautiful resort town!  The beautiful villas were originally built in 1933.  The charm lies in the landscaping, lighting, palm trees, the views of the San Jacinto mountains, and the cozy, intimate feel of every inch of this property.  
 
 I love a hotel that’s not just for tourists!  Although Palm Springs is a “resort lifestyle”, locals like the feel of “escaping”.  The location is ideal- close to the Palm Springs Art Museum and all the happenings of downtown Palm Springs. And yet, when you’re on the property, it feels tucked away, quiet, and serene.  (Well, it’s all in the name- La Serena = serene) 
 The icing on the cake of this property is that its restaurant- Azúcar (sugar) is delicious and satisfying!  The décor includes Frida Kahlo and calaveras (skulls)… It will be up to your own determination whether the calaveras is symbolic for social equality, human mortality, a celebration of life, or a “party animal”, one who loves the nightlife!  The setting is perfect for a chill meet up with friends, whether you are inside or on the rooftop.  There is not a bad seat.  Go for the appetizers, cocktails, or full menu.  The food is fresh and flavorful and the setting is idyllic!
 
 #blackinpalmsprings #rooftopbar #luxuryvillas #fyp

accounts.caption: ⭐⭐⭐⭐☆ (4/5) Wir haben insgesamt einen sehr schönen Urlaub im Stella Beach Resort & Spa verbracht und würden das Hotel grundsätzlich weiterempfehlen. Schon beim Betreten der Anlage fällt auf, wie wunderschön und gepflegt das gesamte Resort ist. Die vielen Palmen, Blumen und Grünanlagen schaffen eine tolle Atmosphäre und laden zum Entspannen ein. Überall wird auf Sauberkeit geachtet und die Anlage wird kontinuierlich gepflegt. Unser erstes Zimmer im ersten Stock war bereits sehr schön. Es war sauber, geräumig und wir haben uns dort sofort wohlgefühlt. Ein ganz besonderes Lob geht an die beiden Roomboys. Sie haben jeden Tag hervorragende Arbeit geleistet, waren immer freundlich und haben unser Zimmer mit viel Sorgfalt gereinigt. Dafür möchten wir uns herzlich bedanken. Das Essen war insgesamt in Ordnung. Die Auswahl war ausreichend und abwechslungsreich, sodass jeder etwas Passendes finden konnte. Natürlich hat nicht alles unseren persönlichen Geschmack getroffen, aber das ist bei einem Buffet völlig normal. Es wurde regelmäßig nachgefüllt und man musste nicht befürchten, dass etwas ausgeht. Ein ganz besonderes Lob möchten wir dem Mitarbeiter an der Poolbar aussprechen. Obwohl er die Poolbar oft alleine betreut hat, war er jederzeit freundlich, aufmerksam und unglaublich engagiert. Man wurde immer schnell bedient und hatte das Gefühl, als Gast willkommen zu sein. Ebenso möchten wir die Lifeguards hervorheben. Sie waren jederzeit präsent, freundlich und aufmerksam. Man hat gemerkt, dass ihnen die Sicherheit der Gäste wichtig ist, ohne dabei aufdringlich zu wirken. Auch das Management möchten wir positiv erwähnen. Nachdem wir unsere Kritik angesprochen hatten, wurde sich Zeit für unser Anliegen genommen und nach einer Lösung gesucht. Leider begann unser Urlaub jedoch mit einer großen Enttäuschung. Nach einer langen Anreise kamen wir gegen 23:30 Uhr im Hotel an und mussten trotzdem fast zwei Stunden auf unser Zimmer warten. Erst weit nach 1:30 Uhr konnten wir unser Zimmer beziehen. Nach einem langen Reisetag war das sehr ärgerlich und hätte deutlich besser organisiert werden müssen. Auch der Service im Hauptrestaurant hat uns leider nicht überzeugt. Obwohl das Essen in Ordnung war, wurden Getränke nur selten an den Tisch gebracht. Unterstützung bei der Suche nach einem freien Tisch gab es praktisch nicht. Gerade zu den Stoßzeiten musste man sich selbst organisieren, was den Aufenthalt unnötig erschwert hat. Nach unserer Beschwerde über den langen Check-in und den fehlenden Service im Restaurant bot uns das Management die Möglichkeit, gegen Aufpreis in ein Swim-up-Zimmer zu wechseln. Dieses Angebot haben wir angenommen und waren mit dem neuen Zimmer sehr zufrieden. Das Swim-up-Zimmer war wirklich wunderschön und hat unseren Urlaub noch einmal deutlich aufgewertet. Trotz der genannten Kritikpunkte überwiegen für uns die positiven Eindrücke. Die wunderschöne Anlage, die gepflegten Zimmer, die hervorragende Arbeit der Roomboys, der außergewöhnlich engagierte Mitarbeiter an der Poolbar, die aufmerksamen Lifeguards und das bemühte Management haben unseren Urlaub zu einem schönen und erholsamen Erlebnis gemacht. Wenn der Check-in besser organisiert wird und der Service im Hauptrestaurant aufmerksamer ist, hat dieses Hotel aus unserer Sicht das Potenzial für volle fünf Sterne. #Ägypten #Hurghada #MakadiBay #TravelTok #HotelReview

accounts.caption: Luxurious and spacious hotel rooms may catch your eye, but exceptional service is what you'll remember long after checkout. When comparing luxury hotels, it's easy to focus on suite size, marble bathrooms, ocean views, and private terraces. But those amenities only tell part of the story.  The true difference between a good stay and an unforgettable one comes down to hospitality, staffing, and personalized service. A larger suite is a one-time investment. Outstanding service requires daily investment in hiring, training, and retaining exceptional staff. That's why some of the world's best luxury brands prioritize guest-to-staff ratios and personalized experiences over simply offering bigger rooms. If you're booking a newly opened luxury hotel, keep in mind that even the most beautiful property may need time to perfect its service. Great hospitality isn't built overnight. What's the biggest luxury hotel green flag for you? Let us know in the comments! #LuxuryTravel #LuxuryHotels #TravelTips

audioAnalysis.transcript: A bigger suite does not guarantee better service, and one of those is much easier for hotels to show before you book. Every hotel website is full of room photos, ceiling height, marble bathrooms, private terraces. Those are tangible, easy to market and easy to compare side by side. Service is different. You can't photograph attentiveness. You don't know how quickly someone answers the phone or remembers your preferences until you are actually there. That's why I pay attention to staffing. Four Seasons' new yacht launched with a one-to-one guest-to-staff ratio, and it's one of the headline luxury features. Questo ti dice qualcosa di importante. L'industria in sé sa che il servizio eccezionale viene da avere abbastanza persone per actually deliver it. Un suite più grande è un investimento di un tempo. Un grande servizio è un costo ogni giorno. L'intervistare, allenare e ritirare staff eccezionali è una delle parti più difficili di running a luxury hotel. Questa è una delle ragioni per le quali non vado a hotel fino a quando sono stati aperti per sei mesi o neanche un anno. Ho attenuto molte aprile di hotel e il servizio è solitamente un messaggio. Bari nubili, staff confuso, servizio di turn down che non è mai avuto e tutto è molto veloce. Grazie a tutti.

Westgate Las Vegas: The Best Hotel Ever If you’re looking for a Las Vegas hotel that has everything you could possibly want under one roof, Westgate Las Vegas Resort & Casino deserves a serious look. Located just one block from the Las Vegas Strip and directly next to the Las Vegas Convention Center, Westgate combines classic Vegas atmosphere with an incredible selection of entertainment, dining, gaming, and amenities. (Westgate Resorts) One of the biggest advantages is convenience. Westgate has its own Las Vegas Monorail station, making it easy to get around without having to rely entirely on a car or rideshare. The resort is also connected to the Vegas Loop. (Westgate Resorts) Inside the resort, there’s plenty to do. Guests can enjoy a massive casino, the famous Westgate SuperBook, a pool with cabanas, a fitness center, Serenity Spa, tennis and pickleball courts, shopping, live entertainment, and an extensive selection of restaurants. (Westgate Resorts) Food is another major reason to stay. Westgate offers everything from Benihana and Edge Steakhouse to Fresco Italiano, sushi, Asian cuisine, pizza, tacos, coffee, and casual dining. You can spend an entire day at the resort without ever needing to leave for a meal. (Westgate Resorts) And then there’s the entertainment. Westgate has hosted major performers and currently features entertainment options including Barry Manilow and other live shows. (Westgate Resorts) For sports fans, Westgate is especially impressive. Its SuperBook is one of the property’s signature attractions, while the casino offers approximately 95,000 square feet of gaming space with slots, table games, poker, and sportsbook action. (Westgate Resorts) The resort also offers some seriously extravagant accommodations. Its Sky Villas include enormous luxury spaces with features such as private pools, full bars, media rooms, and Strip views. (Westgate Resorts) So, is Westgate literally the best hotel in Las Vegas? That’s obviously subjective. But if your definition of the best hotel means great location, tons of restaurants, casino action, entertainment, transportation, sports betting, a pool, spa, and plenty to do without leaving the property, Westgate has a very strong argument. For a classic Las Vegas experience with practically everything in one place, Westgate Las Vegas is hard to ignore.

Traveling solo can feel intimidating, but Terranea made me feel completely at ease from the moment I arrived. The property is absolutely stunning, perched on the cliffs of Rancho Palos Verdes with endless Pacific Ocean views around every corner. Whether I was walking the coastal trails, relaxing by one of the pools, or simply sitting with a cup of coffee overlooking the water, it was the kind of place that made it easy to slow down and recharge. If you’re planning a stay, don’t skip the spa. Spending a few hours there was one of the highlights of my trip and the perfect complement to the peaceful atmosphere of the resort. While Terranea has access to a beautiful cove, it’s more of a rocky shoreline where you can explore the tide pools or launch a kayak rather than a traditional sandy swimming beach. Between the adults-only pool, multiple family-friendly pools, incredible restaurants, and unforgettable ocean views, it’s a luxury getaway I’d recommend to anyone—but especially if you’re looking for a restorative solo escape.

AZÚCAR ROOFTOP SUNSET MIXER
 
 Azúcar restaurant @azucarpalmsprings at La Serena Villas @laserenavillas in Palm Springs has always been visually and energetically appealing to me!
 
 We experienced the magical rooftop at their rooftop sunset mixer!  This was a special event for several business owners in the area (the support from local business owners is unmatched).
 
 The energy of this place feels so good that I had to ask someone to show me around the property because I’m always down for a doing a “staycation” in our beautiful resort town!  The beautiful villas were originally built in 1933.  The charm lies in the landscaping, lighting, palm trees, the views of the San Jacinto mountains, and the cozy, intimate feel of every inch of this property.  
 
 I love a hotel that’s not just for tourists!  Although Palm Springs is a “resort lifestyle”, locals like the feel of “escaping”.  The location is ideal- close to the Palm Springs Art Museum and all the happenings of downtown Palm Springs. And yet, when you’re on the property, it feels tucked away, quiet, and serene.  (Well, it’s all in the name- La Serena = serene) 
 The icing on the cake of this property is that its restaurant- Azúcar (sugar) is delicious and satisfying!  The décor includes Frida Kahlo and calaveras (skulls)… It will be up to your own determination whether the calaveras is symbolic for social equality, human mortality, a celebration of life, or a “party animal”, one who loves the nightlife!  The setting is perfect for a chill meet up with friends, whether you are inside or on the rooftop.  There is not a bad seat.  Go for the appetizers, cocktails, or full menu.  The food is fresh and flavorful and the setting is idyllic!
 
 #blackinpalmsprings #rooftopbar #luxuryvillas #fyp
 @DandyInPalmSprings

Với Serena Riverside, nền tảng ấy được khẳng định bởi Đạt Phước - Chủ đầu tư theo đuổi định hướng phát triển bằng những giá trị thực, kinh nghiệm triển khai vững vàng và cam kết dài hạn với khách hàng. 💎 Nền tảng vững vàng Đạt Phước được phát triển trên nền tảng hệ sinh thái HKK – Khóa kéo Hoàn Mỹ với hơn 30 năm hình thành và phát triển cùng năng lực tài chính vững mạnh, tạo điểm tựa cho chiến lược đầu tư bài bản và dài hạn. 🏗️ Tiến độ vượt kỳ vọng Tại dự án The Rivana, Đạt Phước đã từng ghi dấu năng lực triển khai khi hoàn thiện bàn giao dự án vào năm 2023 (sớm hơn 1 quý so với cam kết) – một minh chứng rõ nét cho khả năng tổ chức và kiểm soát tiến độ. 📜 Cam kết được hiện thực hóa Chỉ khoảng một năm sau khi nhận nhà, cư dân The Rivana đã được trao Giấy chứng nhận quyền sở hữu - dấu mốc pháp lý khẳng định cam kết của Chủ đầu tư và giá trị bền vững được hoàn thiện đến cùng. 🤝 Chuẩn mực trong lựa chọn đối tác Từ thiết kế đến thi công, Đạt Phước ưu tiên hợp tác cùng những đơn vị giàu kinh nghiệm như Ong&Ong – Singapore, Coteccons, An Phong..., hướng đến việc kiểm soát chất lượng xuyên suốt quá trình phát triển. 🌿 Giá trị phát triển nhất quán Chất lượng – Tận tâm – Chính trực là những giá trị được Đạt Phước theo đuổi, tạo nên nền tảng cho mỗi dự án trước khi trở thành một sản phẩm được trao đến khách hàng. 💫 Từ những dấu ấn đã được tạo dựng, Đạt Phước tiếp tục hành trình với Serena Riverside - Home Resort bên sông Sài Gòn, tiếp nối định hướng kiến tạo những không gian sống chỉn chu, giàu trải nghiệm và tạo dựng giá trị bền vững theo thời gian.#serenariverside #ravana #canhosaigon

✨ Mi experiencia en Refugio Verde, Las Terrenas. 🌿🤍 Si estás buscando un lugar donde puedas descansar, desconectarte y disfrutar de la naturaleza sin alejarte de todo, definitivamente tienes que conocer Refugio Verde. 📍 Está ubicado en el Boulevard de Las Terrenas, Samaná, una excelente ubicación que te permite llegar fácilmente a diferentes playas, restaurantes y atractivos de la zona. Lo primero que me gustó fue la tranquilidad del lugar. Desde que llegas sientes un ambiente relajante, rodeado de vegetación y con unas instalaciones muy limpias y modernas. Las habitaciones son cómodas, amplias y muy acogedoras, ideales tanto para una escapada en pareja como para disfrutar unos días de descanso. Otro detalle que me encantó fue la piscina, perfecta para relajarte después de recorrer Las Terrenas o simplemente disfrutar del día sin salir del hotel. Si eres de los que busca un lugar bonito para descansar y, al mismo tiempo, tener todo relativamente cerca, este lugar es una muy buena opción. ✔️ Ambiente tranquilo. ✔️ Habitaciones modernas y confortables. ✔️ Rodeado de naturaleza. ✔️ Excelente ubicación en Las Terrenas. Gracias a todo el equipo de Refugio Verde por hacerme sentir como en casa. 🌿🤍 #LasTerrenas #Samaná #RefugioVerde #RepúblicaDominicana #HotelBoutique

⭐⭐⭐⭐☆ (4/5) Wir haben insgesamt einen sehr schönen Urlaub im Stella Beach Resort & Spa verbracht und würden das Hotel grundsätzlich weiterempfehlen. Schon beim Betreten der Anlage fällt auf, wie wunderschön und gepflegt das gesamte Resort ist. Die vielen Palmen, Blumen und Grünanlagen schaffen eine tolle Atmosphäre und laden zum Entspannen ein. Überall wird auf Sauberkeit geachtet und die Anlage wird kontinuierlich gepflegt. Unser erstes Zimmer im ersten Stock war bereits sehr schön. Es war sauber, geräumig und wir haben uns dort sofort wohlgefühlt. Ein ganz besonderes Lob geht an die beiden Roomboys. Sie haben jeden Tag hervorragende Arbeit geleistet, waren immer freundlich und haben unser Zimmer mit viel Sorgfalt gereinigt. Dafür möchten wir uns herzlich bedanken. Das Essen war insgesamt in Ordnung. Die Auswahl war ausreichend und abwechslungsreich, sodass jeder etwas Passendes finden konnte. Natürlich hat nicht alles unseren persönlichen Geschmack getroffen, aber das ist bei einem Buffet völlig normal. Es wurde regelmäßig nachgefüllt und man musste nicht befürchten, dass etwas ausgeht. Ein ganz besonderes Lob möchten wir dem Mitarbeiter an der Poolbar aussprechen. Obwohl er die Poolbar oft alleine betreut hat, war er jederzeit freundlich, aufmerksam und unglaublich engagiert. Man wurde immer schnell bedient und hatte das Gefühl, als Gast willkommen zu sein. Ebenso möchten wir die Lifeguards hervorheben. Sie waren jederzeit präsent, freundlich und aufmerksam. Man hat gemerkt, dass ihnen die Sicherheit der Gäste wichtig ist, ohne dabei aufdringlich zu wirken. Auch das Management möchten wir positiv erwähnen. Nachdem wir unsere Kritik angesprochen hatten, wurde sich Zeit für unser Anliegen genommen und nach einer Lösung gesucht. Leider begann unser Urlaub jedoch mit einer großen Enttäuschung. Nach einer langen Anreise kamen wir gegen 23:30 Uhr im Hotel an und mussten trotzdem fast zwei Stunden auf unser Zimmer warten. Erst weit nach 1:30 Uhr konnten wir unser Zimmer beziehen. Nach einem langen Reisetag war das sehr ärgerlich und hätte deutlich besser organisiert werden müssen. Auch der Service im Hauptrestaurant hat uns leider nicht überzeugt. Obwohl das Essen in Ordnung war, wurden Getränke nur selten an den Tisch gebracht. Unterstützung bei der Suche nach einem freien Tisch gab es praktisch nicht. Gerade zu den Stoßzeiten musste man sich selbst organisieren, was den Aufenthalt unnötig erschwert hat. Nach unserer Beschwerde über den langen Check-in und den fehlenden Service im Restaurant bot uns das Management die Möglichkeit, gegen Aufpreis in ein Swim-up-Zimmer zu wechseln. Dieses Angebot haben wir angenommen und waren mit dem neuen Zimmer sehr zufrieden. Das Swim-up-Zimmer war wirklich wunderschön und hat unseren Urlaub noch einmal deutlich aufgewertet. Trotz der genannten Kritikpunkte überwiegen für uns die positiven Eindrücke. Die wunderschöne Anlage, die gepflegten Zimmer, die hervorragende Arbeit der Roomboys, der außergewöhnlich engagierte Mitarbeiter an der Poolbar, die aufmerksamen Lifeguards und das bemühte Management haben unseren Urlaub zu einem schönen und erholsamen Erlebnis gemacht. Wenn der Check-in besser organisiert wird und der Service im Hauptrestaurant aufmerksamer ist, hat dieses Hotel aus unserer Sicht das Potenzial für volle fünf Sterne. #Ägypten #Hurghada #MakadiBay #TravelTok #HotelReview

NBE removes the 24% credit cap. 📉 But does that mean banks can now lend without limits? Not exactly. • The temporary 24% annual bank credit growth cap has been removed. • The National Bank Rate (policy rate) has been increased from 15% to 16%. • The ±3 percentage-point interest rate corridor remains unchanged. • A targeted reserve requirement has been introduced for banks whose credit growth poses inflationary risks. • The foreign exchange commission rate has been reduced from 2.5% to 1.5%. • The mandatory foreign exchange surrender requirement on goods exports has been reduced from 50% to 30%. • The NBE says it will rely more on interest rate-based (indirect) monetary policy instruments rather than direct lending controls. #update #NBE #bank #credit #fyp

It's walking into a place that used to be my escape and finding my past waiting for me... There's nothing fair or easy about having to NOW see your abuser every day in a place that once brought you peace. What was once my sanctuary, recently has become a minefield I never asked for. Wanna know one of the hardest things about experiencing domestic abuse?  Well, it isn't always the abuse itself...sometimes it's what happens when you finally choose to speak about it. Unfortunately, often times people who find the courage to disclose are met with ugly labels such as "crazy", or "vindictive", that undermine their credibility instead of being met with curiosity and asked, ‘what happened to you?’… Sometimes, the person who caused the suffering is seen as charming and warm and is well liked by peers while the person carrying the scars is doubted and questioned. But what I know, is that people don't always understand what abuse looks like when they've never lived it. Especially when there's no visible marks, bruises, or wounds. So I just keep showing up regardless. Not because it doesn't feel yucky...cuz it does…but because I refuse to let what happened take one more piece of my life from me... And also because sometimes healing looks like walking into the room anyways. #Sur#SurvivorStrongo#EmotionalAbusealingJourney #coercivecontrol #trauma

Norway’s oil fund is one of the best-run resource funds in the world. After oil was discovered in the late 60s, Norway started taxing profits at around 78% and took large ownership stakes. Then, starting in the mid-90s they used the cash flow to set up a sovereign wealth fund managed by Norges Bank, the country’s central bank. They established strict rules to ensure the oil proceeds would support future generations - for example by mandating that the government could only spend the expected real return (currently 3%), so the principal stays invested and compounds. Today the fund is worth about $2.2 trillion, which works out to ~$400,000 USD for every Norwegian, and it owns around 1.5% (!) of the world’s listed companies on average.  But some Norwegians say all that money has started to soften the economy and slow innovation. Productivity growth has stalled, household debt is around 250% of income, sick leave is extremely high, youth dropout rates are elevated, and their high tech is stagnating compared to peers. Some are worried a $2.2 trillion backstop throwing off tens of billions a year is making the economy less dynamic and competitive. Interestingly, we could argue that Americans have a version of the same dynamic through the dollar’s status as the world’s reserve currency. That “exorbitant privilege” lets the U.S. run larger deficits with less market discipline than most countries would face, which also creates long-term fiscal and economic risks. In both cases, a big financial backstop lowers the political and social costs of high spending. The lesson: abundance changes incentives for people and also societies, and the right incentives are crucial for driving innovation and prosperity.

Great question, Coach Keyon. Here’s a complete breakdown of how central banking works, its pros and cons, and how it impacts us—both negatively and positively. ⸻ 🏦 WHAT IS CENTRAL BANKING? A central bank is the top financial authority of a country. In the U.S., this is the Federal Reserve (The Fed). ✅ Main Roles of a Central Bank: 	1.	Issue national currency 	2.	Control inflation (by managing interest rates) 	3.	Regulate and supervise banks 	4.	Control the money supply 	5.	Act as a “lender of last resort” during financial crises ⸻ ⚙️ HOW CENTRAL BANKING WORKS (Simplified) 	1.	Money Creation: 	•	Central banks print money (physically and digitally). 	•	They lend money to commercial banks, which lend to us. 	2.	Setting Interest Rates: 	•	They raise rates to slow down inflation (make borrowing expensive). 	•	They lower rates to stimulate spending and borrowing. 	3.	Open Market Operations: 	•	They buy/sell government bonds to inject or remove money from the economy. 	4.	Regulation & Oversight: 	•	They make rules to stabilize the financial system and prevent banking collapses. ⸻ ✅ PROS OF CENTRAL BANKING Benefit	Description 1. Economic Stability	Prevents massive swings in inflation or recession. 2. Emergency Support	Can step in during crises (like 2008 or COVID-19) to keep banks and markets running. 3. Controls Inflation	Keeps prices from rising too fast. 4. Currency Trust	Maintains confidence in the dollar through regulation. 5. Full Employment Goal	Policies are designed to help maintain jobs and productivity. ⸻ ❌ CONS OF CENTRAL BANKING Risk	Description 1. Inflation & Money Printing	Too much printing devalues the dollar and leads to rising prices. 2. Wealth Inequality	Low interest rates and asset buying benefit the rich (investors), not average people. 3. Loss of Free Market	Manipulating interest rates distorts true supply and demand. 4. Hidden Tax	Inflation caused by central banks acts like a silent tax on everyone. 5. Debt-Based System	All money is issued as debt—so we’re always borrowing, not truly owning. ⸻ 🧨 HOW CENTRAL BANKING HURTS US (The People) 	1.	We’re always in debt – The system relies on people borrowing, not saving. 	2.	Inflation eats our savings – Money loses value over time. 	3.	Price of living goes up – Food, gas, housing rise faster than wages. 	4.	Wealth gap widens – Rich benefit from asset bubbles; poor struggle with basic costs. 	5.	No real financial freedom – It keeps most people in cycles of loans and payments. ⸻ 💡 HOW CENTRAL BANKING CAN HELP US 	1.	Protects the system from collapse – Prevents runs on banks and massive unemployment during crises. 	2.	Keeps inflation stable – Targeting 2% inflation helps with long-term planning. 	3.	Boosts the economy during recessions – By lowering rates and providing stimulus. 	4.	Provides structure – Without central control, currency could become unstable. 	5.	Encourages investment and credit growth – Helps businesses grow, create jobs, and fuel innovation. ⸻ 🔁 CONCLUSION Impact	Harmful When…	Helpful When… Money Printing	Used excessively	Used in crisis recovery Interest Rate Changes	Misused or too slow	Timely and balanced Debt System	Traps consumers	Fuels responsible business investment Regulation	Overreaches	Prevents corruption and collapse ⸻ 📢 Final Thought from Legacy: Central banking is like a powerful tool—in the wrong hands, it traps people in poverty and debt. In the right moment, it can prevent economic disaster.
